content: Idar Wenni cek dd-ixeřqen deg wussan n temẓi nnec, qbeř i dd ɣa yawḍen wussan n řɣar i zi ɣa tinid: “War daysen ufiɣ řefraḥet!”,
qbeř ad tᵉttwabarcen tfuct d tfawt d tziri d itran uca ad dd-ɛeqben iseynuten awarni i wenẓar,

ɣar wass min di iɛessasen n taddart ad arjijen, iryazen ijehden ad qewsen, tinni iḥarryen tasirt ad ssbeddent tawwuri nsent, minzi nitenti qqiment drus idsent, uca timɣarin nni dd-issajjan zi řkwazi, ad ttwařeḥḥfent s taǧest,
u tnayen n tewwura ɣar zzenqqet ad ttwabellɛent, xmi ddriz n tsirt ad isseɣd uca řḥess n ujḍiḍ ad t issiggwed deg yiḍes u marra yessis n uɣennij ad dewřent qewsent,

u bnadem ad iggʷed zi marra min iǧan yuɛřan, uca ad din iřint ɛřam kuř řeḥwayej inexřiɛen deg webrid, u tacejjart n ǧewz ad tnewwar u aburxes ad idweř d tamara u tanewwact n ‘ukebbas’ war d as dd-yusi ɛad ɣar řbař - maɣar bnadem iggur ɣar taddart nnes n řebda u inni iceṭṭnen ad raḥen ad dd-tasen deg ibriden -
qbeř i ɣa tᵉttwarxu tesɣunt n nnuqart, ad tᵉttwarẓ ṭṭawyyet n wureɣ, ad innefrar weqbuc ɣar tařa uca ad teqḍu tjarrart deg wanu,
uca ucař ad dd-iɛqeb ɣar temmurt am mammec t-tuɣa, u buḥbeř ad dd-iɛqeb ɣar AREBBI, wenni t iwcin.
D ibeṭṭařen qaɛ, iqqar Umbarreḥ, aqa kuřci di řbaṭeř.
Sennej i uya, minzi Ambarreḥ tuɣa-t d amiɣis, isseřmed ɛawed tussna i řgens, tuɣa ittbařu, ittbeqqac mliḥ, uca iɛdeř aṭṭas n wawařen iweznen.
Yarzu Umbarreḥ maḥend ad yaf awařen iɛedřen, u min yura, aqa-t nican, awařen n tidett.
Awařen n imiɣisen am yisennanen u amecnaw imesmiren ittwassidfen, i zzaysen i-dd-ttasent aṭṭas n tmesřayin, aqa-ten mmewcen zeg uyenni n Umeksaw.
Sennej i marra aya, a mmi, ḥḍa ixef nnec: war din aqeṭṭu n tira n waṭṭas n idlisen u aṭṭas n tɣuri tessaḥař arrimet.
Awař aneggaru n marra min tesřid, aqa t d wa: “Ggʷed AREBBI u ḥḍa tiweṣṣa nnes!”, maɣar man aya i yurin i kuř ijj n bnadem.
Maɣar SIDI ad yawi kuř tameggit zzat i taddart n ccreɛ x marra min innuffaren, ma tuɣa iṣbeḥ niɣ tuɣa war iḥři.

footnotes.text: tanewwact n ‘ukebbas’- isem-a n tnewwact tanita s tutlayt n Tlatinit: ‘capparis’. S Teɛrabt ‘الكَبَر’.
